name: Purple Dye Trap
source: Pathfinder #178: Punks in a Powder Keg
description: A spring-loaded glass jar containing purple dye and a thunderstone pops from the ground and explodes when a pressure sensor is triggered.
disable: DC 17 Thievery (trained) to remove the jar and thunderstone carefully or DC 20 Athletics to reinforce the flagstone pressure sensor with an improvised wedge

generalAbilities.name: Exploding Jar
generalAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature or object weighing at least 50 pounds is placed on one of the flagstones running north to south on the west side of the yard (marked "T" on the map)

Effect A glass jar containing purple dye and a thunderstone pop from the ground between the flagstones. The sudden movement causes the thunderstone to clink against the jar and explode. All creatures in a 10-foot radius take 2 Sonic Damage damage and must succeed at a Basic DC 17 Fortitude Saving Throw save or be Deafened for 1 round. In addition, each creature in that area is splattered with purple dye and showered with glass, taking (1d4+2) Piercing Damage damage (Basic DC 20 Reflex Saving Throw). Creatures splattered with purple dye take a -1 circumstance penalty to Charisma-based skill checks. Fully dying the affected hair or clothing removes this penalty. Dyed skin fades after a week but can be covered up with a successful Disguise check and the appropriate cosmetics.
